name: L-Theanine Sleep Use
summary: May support sleep quality, sleep-onset related outcomes, and next-day refreshment in some adult contexts.
description: L-theanine for sleep is used based on CNS-calming plausibility, including modulation of glutamatergic signaling and stress arousal; evidence varies by formulation and dose.
safetyNotes: Sleep-support evidence exists, but safety and efficacy are not proven for all insomnia populations. Pure L-theanine data should be distinguished from combination formulas.
evidenceLevel: Editorial grade not demonstrated by recorded studies
